messages:
Lena: Quick thread to capture the evidence-snapshot playbook we discussed. Goal: satisfy enterprise contracts (7y) without full search costs.
Sam: Proposal: two-tier retention + on-demand notarized snapshots. Short-term (90d) searchable. Long-term (archive) stored as signed blobs with manifest.
Nina: From infra: snapshots should be immutable, chunked, and stored with content-addressable names. We can reuse our cold-archive bucket and lifecycle rules.
Arman: API idea: POST /v1/tenants/:id/snapshots with body {range, type: "scheduled|on-demand", include_keys: "true|false"}. Response returns snapshot_id + manifest_url.
Lena: Good. Legal-Jane, what must the manifest include to be contract-worthy?
Legal-Jane: Must include tenant_id, snapshot_ts, granular checksum list (sha256 per file), KMS key fingerprint, signer identity, timezone-normalized timestamps, and a human-readable chain-of-custody statement. Prefer RFC3339 times.
Sam: Also add an audit proof: we should include a signed log entry referencing the snapshot id in the immutable audit stream so customers can validate issuance.
Nina: Ops constraints: creating snapshots for all tenants nightly is expensive. We should allow customers to opt-in per-tenant and default to scheduled monthly for large accounts.
Arman: Pricing: charge per-GB/month stored in archive plus a per-export fee for producing a notarized bundle. Billing tag: retention:archived=true, snapshot_schedule=monthly|on-demand.
Lena: UX: in Console show a "Retention & Evidence" tab with TTL slider, snapshot schedule, and export history. Provide quick toggles: "Create export now" and "Request notarized bundle".
Sam: For MVP acceptance criteria: 1) snapshot API implemented; 2) manifests include required fields; 3) snapshots stored immutably in cold-archive; 4) signed audit reference; 5) billing tags emitted.
Nina: Post-MVP stretch: searchable archive indexing, expedited restore SLA, HSM key escrow integration.
Legal-Jane: Also require retention policy docs and a proof-of-process runbook for auditors: who can request exports, SLA for export generation, and retention deletion proofs.
Arman: Security checklist: snapshot encryption using customer KMS if BYOK enabled; fallback server-side key with strict access logs if BYOK absent. Key-rewrap process for rotation must be automatable.
Lena: Edge cases: tenant requests immediate deletion while snapshot in-flight; tenant moves from Dedicated to Hosted — need migration plan for keys and snapshots. Add to spec.
Sam: Timeline: MVP scoped to 2 backend sprints + 1 infra sprint. Deliverables: API, storage pipeline, signing service, billing tags, console toggles.
Nina: Monitoring: metrics on snapshot queue size, average snapshot time, archive put failures, and monthly archive GB per tenant. Alerts for >5% failure rate.
Legal-Jane: Contract language suggestion: "Provider will retain notarized evidence snapshots for the agreed retention period in immutable archive. Requests for exported evidence will be fulfilled within X business days; expedited fulfillment available for a fee."
Arman: We'll need an export format example. Suggest gzipped tar containing directories: /audit/, /meta/, /signatures/, plus manifest.json. Example manifest content in spec.
Lena: Action items: Sam -> write API spec and example export manifest (due Tue). Nina -> infra cost estimate and lifecycle rules (due Wed). Arman -> billing tag + console mockups (due Thu). Legal-Jane -> contract clause drafts for 90d vs 7y (due Tue).
ops-bot: Reminder: monthly-retention sync scheduled 2026-05-07 10:00.
Lena: Thanks all. We'll validate with two customers (one wants 90d, one requires 7y) and incorporate feedback before product-review.
